files.description: Screenshot of the FHIR Resources index page showing the full list of FHIR resources supported by BroadStreet's (g)(10) API: 12 clinical resources and 11 reference resources, all standard US Core STU 5.0.1.

2025 Real World Testing Plan (15 pages). Contains Test Case 4 for (b)(10) EHI Export: describes testing in production at assisted living facilities, tracking export frequency and completion times, and verifying compatibility with external systems. Also covers (b)(1), (b)(2), (e)(1), (c)(1-3), (g)(7), (g)(9), (g)(10), and (h)(1) test cases.
